title: Quint Verification Report
description: Machine-readable verdict for a Quint spec verification: typecheck + per-invariant safety (expect satisfied) + per-witness liveness (expect reached/violated). Ported from quint-llm's verification-report, adapted to the DSH quint-verify runner. Note the faithful-but-confusing witness terms: result 'violated' = reached = GOOD (liveness); 'satisfied' = unreachable = CONCERN.

parameters.description: Const parameter values if the module is parameterized

invariants.description: Safety checks. SATISFIED = good (holds in sampled traces); VIOLATED = bug.

satisfied.description: No counterexample found in the sampled traces

violated.description: A trace disproved the invariant — a bug

seed.description: Reproduction seed, present only when violated

witnesses.description: Liveness checks. 'violated' (reached in >0 traces) = good; 'satisfied' (0 traces) = unreachable = concern.

violated.description: Witnesses reached in >0 traces — scenarios are reachable (good)

traces.description: Traces that reached the witness state

verdict.description: pass iff every invariant is satisfied AND every witness is reached (>0 traces)
